title.en: An Act to Remit Arrears in the Cedula Tax and Penalties, Provided the Tax for the Year Nineteen Hundred and thirty-Seven Is Paid Before the First of May of that Year.

text.en:
Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, any person delinquent in the payment of
and who shall pay the cedula tax for the year nineteen hundred and thirty-seven before the first of May of that
year, shall be relieved from further obligation as to arrears and penalties in the cedula tax.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nine-teen hundred and thirty-seven.
Approved, October 29, 1936.
